title: /ops judges the Add site design system preview with one detector per kind of error, as the frame shows it, and holds Publish when it is not measured
steps: S1: Run the detector tests: every kind fails on its broken sample cut from a real 14/10 preview and passes on a clean one.

S2: Run the measurement tests: detector kinds feed their rules, an unmeasured preview rule is never a pass, a row without its stylesheets counts for PREV-1 only, a kind one system causes on most templates is the system's.
S3: Run the readiness, Road to live and live preview door tests: unmeasured preview rules and DEMO-1 are must-fix, a failing asset door fails PREV-1.
expect: S3: every readiness, road and door health test passes.
evidence: 14/10/2026: after PR 1356 the eye audits of every Moxie preview found about 25 kinds of error (inverted logos, half-recoloured gradients, inflated and collapsed buttons, black strips, empty slabs, unreadable cover titles, an unstyled preview behind a 502 asset door) while /ops passed or marked the template not measured
fence: apps/tracy-web: scripts/preview-check.mjs, scripts/preview-detectors/*, src/sites/design-system-preview-probe.js, src/lib/preview-door-health.js, readiness rules and rule-severity.json, road-to-live.js, ops/quickstarts.js; packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/src/measurement.mjs; packages/web/tracy-harness RoadToLive and Templates; scripts/tdsr/preview-measure-all.mjs, preview-system-issues.mjs, preview-lines.mjs.
